notes.title: Rog & Roll Adventure Demo Release!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38875356/2ecdfd0ef272766dfb03a27cef038dcbc7e113ce.png

Just in time for this year’s Steam Next Fest - the Rog & Roll Adventure Demo has been released!

DEMO FEATURES:

 Complete the first world of the game!
 Play in Adventure Mode, which includes story cutscenes, a tutorial, an item shop, and an overworld to explore…
 Or stick with Vintage Mode, and play through levels in a more classic streamlined experience!
 Complete the demo to unlock a Level Select mode (plus 2 BONUS LEVELS!)
Try it now for free on PC or Mac!
If you encounter any bugs or issues (or just want to share your impressions), please pass them along by selecting the Feedback option either from the main menu or from the Pause menu during gameplay.

Thanks so much for playing! If you enjoy the demo, please consider wishlisting the game - and keep an eye out for the full version, which should be rolling your way very soon!
